{{Quote|Viso is the Queen's staunchest supporter|Jono Dunn, on Viso|<ref name="Jedi Apprentice: The Mark of the Crown">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Mark of the Crown]]''</ref>}}
'''Viso''' was a [[Galacian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Council Minister]] who had served at the heels of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Cana]] and [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Veda (Galacian)|Veda]]. As time went on, he became blind, but knew his way around the palace and usually passed the royal gardens. He was also aware of Cana's secret past just before the King died.

On the day of the [[Galacian Gubernatorial election, 44 BBY|gubernatorial election]] in [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]], Visa revealed everything to Cana's son, [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Beju]], after the old Galacian put a stop to a [[Duel on Gala|duel]] between the Prince and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. He had Beju tested before the [[Mark of the Crown]] and it turned out negative, just as he knew it would. Beju's half-sister, [[Elan Tallah|Elan]], was the true heir to the throne.
